# MapleMoon masked founder grade report

Status: review output only. Nothing was wired, deployed, published, sent or approved.

## Probe sets and method

- Photo-final probe: 10 WebPs, exactly every assets/photo_finals/*.webp except maplemoon_heros73_brandmatched.webp.
- Count ruling: Exact glob minus heros73 gives 10, although the handoff prose says nine.
- Skin reference: carli1_graded_full.png, carli2_graded_full.png, dyl1_graded_full.png, dyl2_graded_full.png.
- Skin reference limitation: The photo-final set contains no people and therefore no semantic skin pixels. The four previously graded founder masters supply the agreed warm-skin target.
- Skin isolation: native-resolution named face ellipses followed by an RGB plus YCbCr rule on fully opaque pixels only: alpha=255, Y>=62, R>=72, G>=42, B>=28, R>1.035G, R>1.09B, chroma>=16, Cb 76..126 and Cr 134..178. This excludes arms, hands, hair masses, carob and clothing. The spatial support was fixed from each source before grading.
- Neutral/clothing isolation: fully opaque, non-skin pixels with chroma<=24 or cool-fabric ratios, luminance 10..245. Product finals supply a palette diagnostic; the prior founder masters supply the semantically valid clothing target.
- Black and white points below are robust luminance p01 and p99, not absolute extrema.
- Pipeline: reused the established 3x3 matrix plus monotone per-channel LUT architecture. The coefficients were refit from four exact prior founder source-to-grade pairs because the earlier numeric fit was tied to one different crop.
